question: At the actual recognition clock, how much of the dipole lifecycle remains?
interpretation: About half of operational lifecycles are already over when the detector reports; the recognizable moment arrives after the one-sided window has usually been broken.
observed_correspondence: Lifecycles ended (third opposite second completed) at or before recognition_receive_ns: Oct 2 383/741 (0.517), Oct 3 456/832 (0.548), Oct 17 383/740 (0.518), Oct 18 432/863 (0.501). Remaining life among the rest: p50 43.4/44.6/45.5/51.1 s, p90 207/260/188/244 s.
applicability_conditions: All four dates, all live archived candidates
unresolved_aspects: Whether a different endpoint (price-based) would give a different share
endpoint: n/a (negative lead: recognition is 0 to 575 s after the endpoint for the ended half)
measured_lead_time: endpoint is a convention; finalization-only candidates (1 on Oct 3, 1 on Oct 17) excluded from live counts

question: Does any decision-time dipole field sort remaining life?
interpretation: The recorded flow state at emission sorts remaining life strongly; it is partly definitional (opposite flow is the endpoint rule) but it is available at recognition.
observed_correspondence: Ended before recognition by flow_state: opposite 171/181, 200/208, 152/158, 201/217 (0.93-0.96); same 109/213, 131/257, 110/217, 127/275 (0.46-0.51); undefined 92/322, 109/341, 113/347, 88/345 (0.26-0.33). Undefined window before recognition -> remaining life p50 48-59 s vs 23-30 s otherwise.
unresolved_aspects: Whether the 'undefined' state (no prints in 20 s) is a quiet-market effect rather than dipole content
measured_lead_time: flow_state is a Codex-recorded label at emission

question: After recognition, does price continue in the birth direction?
interpretation: No average directional edge after recognition on any date, by either outcome construct.
applicability_conditions: All four dates; also within SAME, FLIP, each flow_state, each touch relation
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Oct 18 midpoint construct leans up (423/362) while the print construct leans down (354/382) — the two constructs disagree in sign on ~45% of candidates at 60 s
unresolved_aspects: Whether any subset cell (none found in 19 cells x 4 days) carries direction
source_references: tables/m1_decision_cells.csv; Markets@24da878 dipole-post-recognition rows; markets-data@87dc338 a-trades
measured_lead_time: Each day one dependent set; no pooling

question: Does the pre-recognition drift (birth to recognition) continue afterwards?
interpretation: On Oct 18 (only day with the label) price moved with the birth direction by recognition in 382 vs 278 against; those that moved against were mostly already dead (215/278 ended); neither group shows continuation afterwards.
applicability_conditions: Oct 18 only (field undefined for other dates in the source)
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Direction after recognition does not follow the pre-recognition move
unresolved_aspects: Why the field is undefined on Oct 2/3/17 in the Ccode rows
measured_lead_time: single date

question: What does the recognition lag look like and does it relate to remaining life?
interpretation: Lag p50 51.7-52.3 s with a shoulder below 40 s (93-121 per day) and a tail above 56 s (187-235). Longer lag goes with longer lifecycles (selection), not with more remaining life per se.
observed_correspondence: Lag >56 s: life p50 80-94 s, remaining p50 66-83 s, ended-before 0.33-0.39; lag 49-56 s: life p50 31-40 s, ended-before 0.59-0.68.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Lag <40 s cells show ended-before 0.27-0.32 with life p50 28-33 s
unresolved_aspects: Which reference second produces the sub-40 s class (open in both analysts' records)

question: After a midpoint jump of at least 2 ticks, does price return?
interpretation: Most large moves return fully to the pre-move quote within 600 s, after first extending in the first 5 s.
applicability_conditions: All four dates; both directions (23/23, 28/30, 33/24, 34/30 up/down)
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: No full return within 600 s: 11/46, 10/58, 15/57, 15/64; one window incomplete on Oct 17 and Oct 18
unresolved_aspects: Return is not separated by prior-signal agreement (agree-majority 15/23, 21/24, 19/23, 22/30 vs disagree 19/21, 26/31, 21/31, 25/32), by jump size, or by print count
numerator_denominator: move known_by_ns (+5 s for the extreme)
decision_clock: first full return to pre-move quote within 600 s (source definition); not event death
measured_lead_time: small n per date; recovery clock measured by the source

question: What happens in the first 5-20 s after the jump?
interpretation: Roughly half continue and half reverse at 5 s and 20 s; the extreme is usually reached inside 5 s, i.e. the jump is followed by a short continuation burst before the return.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Oct 18 20 s leans to reversal (28 vs 20)
unresolved_aspects: MAE/MFE paths after +5 s are not in the packet

question: When a displayed touch becomes one lot, does the level hold or break?
interpretation: Breaking (retreat) depends on how the level became thin and on fresh flow: a standing best that shrank to one lot while fresh flow attacks it retreats about two thirds of the time; a new best quote of one lot with flow going the other way holds about two thirds of the time.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Onset with a print in the same group retreats 0.68-0.69 vs 0.42-0.45 without (the print is part of the mechanism); prior three closes 'falling' 0.66-0.70
unresolved_aspects: Episode durations are milliseconds (p50 1.2 ms, p90 0.1-0.34 s): a market fact, but no human-speed decision
measured_lead_time: a retreat is the quote moving through the level; this is the most mechanical layer in the packet

question: How do thin levels end?
interpretation: Retreats are produced by trades through the level in roughly 56-63% and by pulled quotes in 37-44%; recoveries are replenishment (adds) in essentially all cases.
observed_correspondence: retreated: fill-linked 6753/10663, 7909/12187, 7244/12605, 7108/12677; unlinked reduction 3910, 4278, 5361, 5569. recovered_same_price: added 14365/11218 episodes (ratio >1 means multiple adds), fill_linked 1,0,0,0.
unresolved_aspects: Which participants replenish is not observable

question: Do pressure signals carry 1-30 s direction?
interpretation: After a size-one onset the midpoint is up more often than down at 1 and 5 s on BOTH sides and all four dates; early-falling shows a smaller up bias; retreat-previous-second shows a down bias. The sign convention of the source field must be verified before this is used.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: retreat_previous_second: down > up on both sides (e.g. ask 0.33 vs 0.28)
unresolved_aspects: Orientation of signed_midpoint_change_twice_raw and the 1 ms hypothetical entry; whether 'size one at the ask' is predominantly produced by buy aggression (then an up continuation is mechanical)
measured_lead_time: see CONFLICTS C9

question: Does recent aggressor flow at a family start predict the next seconds?
interpretation: Weak continuation at 1-5 s that decays to coin-flip by 60-300 s on every date.
unresolved_aspects: Spread (mostly 1-2 ticks) vs the 1-2 tick continuation is unmeasured in these tables
source_references: Markets@3d0b06a t1_family_master.csv; markets-data@c6e99f4 tier1 ledgers; tables/m4_tier1_cells.csv
decision_clock: chg_<h>s from last group known by start+h; censored past 21:00 UTC (0/2/3/4 at 300 s)
measured_lead_time: Tier 1 families are structural first observations, not market births

question: Does displayed depth imbalance at a family start carry direction?
interpretation: The full displayed book is bid-heavy at 90-100% of starts on every date (a standing feature, not a signal); near-depth imbalance is split; touch imbalance gives 0.54-0.59 continuation at 1-20 s decaying by 300 s.
unresolved_aspects: Why the full book is permanently bid-heavy on these sessions (not examined)

question: Does refill at the side being hit predict the next seconds?
interpretation: Yes, with the same sign on all four dates at 1-20 s and gone by 300 s (Ccode measurement reused).
applicability_conditions: All four dates, in-member families with a full 1 s window
unresolved_aspects: Executable only at ms-s latency
measured_lead_time: Ccode's own measurement, not recomputed here

question: Does the prior 120 s price direction relate to the flow at a family start?
interpretation: Flow at the start agrees with the prior 120 s price direction about 62-67% (Oct 18 only): flow follows price on this clock (simultaneous/preceding, not a later response).
observed_correspondence: pre120 vs flow60 agree 0.667 (n=637), flow5 0.624 (527), flow1 0.628 (393); continuation of pre120 direction afterwards 0.58 at 1 s, 0.47 at 60-300 s.
applicability_conditions: Oct 18 only (field absent for other dates)
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Prior-direction continuation is below 0.5 at 60-300 s
unresolved_aspects: Field missing on three dates
measured_lead_time: single date

question: Which 3 s grid couplings hold on all four days?
interpretation: Book-activity persistence (93 pairs beyond every day's line), spread -> next spread change, quote-change count -> next absolute move; signed-move couplings exist in sign (touch imbalance -> dm_5 +0.11..+0.14) but never beyond the line on more than one day.
observed_correspondence: same-sign 4 of 4: book response 675/942, magnitude 219/314, quote response 190/471, flow persistence 89/314, signed move 157/628; beyond line 4 days: 93/1/5/0/0.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: No signed-move or flow-persistence pair beyond the line on >1 day
unresolved_aspects: Line is a per-day shifted-Y 95% reference
measured_lead_time: Ccode measurement reused

question: Does recent price/quote activity predict later book behaviour and later move size?
interpretation: Yes: the count of quote changes over the prior 300 s predicts adds and cancels at both touches over the next 5 s and the absolute 20 s move, on all four days.
unresolved_aspects: Activity clustering vs price causing activity cannot be separated here (shared cause)
measured_lead_time: this is activity-begets-activity, not direction

question: Is the price change leading or simultaneous with touch-size change and flow?
interpretation: Simultaneous: dmid vs supA/supB and vs flow peak at lag 0 on all four days (|rho| 0.48-0.58); the only genuine lead is touch imbalance -> flow by 1 s (+0.02..+0.04).
observed_correspondence: lag-0 rho dmid,supA -0.56/-0.54/-0.58/-0.57; dmid,flow +0.50/+0.48/+0.51/+0.51; timb leads flow 1 s on all days.
unresolved_aspects: 1 s resolution cannot resolve sub-second ordering

question: Can a dipole birth be recognized earlier than the Native detector?
interpretation: Weakening onsets in the live native ratio precede 21-64% of births with 12-32 s median lead, at the cost of 35-67% onsets without a next birth; flow_vanished/flow_resumed are the most precise (0.58-0.65).
observed_correspondence: onset->birth: step 0.42-0.49, expiry-only 0.43-0.53, fresh-opposed 0.38-0.47, flow_vanished 0.61-0.65, flow_resumed 0.58-0.63; coverage 0.64/0.64/0.64/0.64 (step), 0.54-0.56 (vanished); median last lead 12-13 s (step), 19 s (fresh opposed), 30-32 s (vanished).
unresolved_aspects: Direction after an onset is near symmetric (outcome-summary follows/opposes ~equal)
measured_lead_time: onsets are events of the predecessor's decay

question: On Ccode's independent detector, is the dipole spent before a 50 s info horizon?
interpretation: Yes for three of four seed states on every date; never for P (persistent) seeds.
unresolved_aspects: Seed classes are Ccode definitions; not joined to Native SAME/FLIP
measured_lead_time: nominal 50 s, not the actual dispatch clock

question: Does the a-state (fast-collapse vs persistent) known at +60 s sort later direction?
interpretation: No: oriented 300 s and 600 s moves are near symmetric within both states on every date.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Oct 17 A-persistent leans down (130/228) — one date

question: How long until price moves 3 ticks with the dipole direction?
interpretation: Median time to a 3-tick move with the direction is minutes, not seconds, and depends on seed: S seeds 195-379 s, O 445-640 s, P 767-1373 s, X 450-971 s; a 3-tick move in either direction comes first or at the same time in ~85-152 of each class.
observed_correspondence: runway_with3t p50 by seed and date in tables/m7_ccode_cells.csv; censored 3-31 per class
unresolved_aspects: time-to-k-ticks is right-censored at session end

question: Do chain plays (predecessor-based) pay?
interpretation: Too few eligible plays to say: 8/6/15/14 plays per date with mixed return ticks.

question: What happens in the same second as a midpoint change?
interpretation: Mechanical: fills on the side price moved toward, cancels on that side, adds on the side left behind — these are the events that ARE the price change.
observed_correspondence: s0: fill toward>away 3309/445, 3493/476, 3417/440, 4079/513 (candidate paths); add away>toward 3996/1304 etc.; controls identical in shape.
applicability_conditions: All four dates; candidate and control paths alike
date_population: 5,481/5,716/5,878/7,296 candidate price-change seconds; 5,954-7,851 per control set

question: Does the book respond to a price change in the following seconds?
interpretation: Activity roughly doubles for 1-20 s (adds, cancels, fills, prints all ~2x quiet seconds) but with no side asymmetry: the response is more activity on both sides, not a directional replenishment or withdrawal.
applicability_conditions: All four dates, candidate and control paths
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: No asymmetry: toward and away counts within a few percent
unresolved_aspects: Which part of the extra activity is reaction and which is the same cluster of activity that produced the move (shared cause) cannot be separated at 1 s

question: After a midpoint change, does the next move continue or reverse?
interpretation: Reverse more often than continue at 5 and 20 s on every date and in both populations (the familiar bounce of a 1-2 tick spread).
measured_lead_time: mostly 1-tick changes

question: Does the book response predict continuation vs reversal once the overlap with the outcome is removed?
interpretation: Only weakly. Conditioning on +2..+5 s adds and measuring +5..+20 s removes most of the apparent effect; conditioning on +1 s events while excluding the +1 s price move is reported in tables/m8_feedback_s1_nonoverlap.json. The strong raw association (adds on the attacked side -> reversal) is largely the reversal itself.
unresolved_aspects: See M8c table for the +1 s version
measured_lead_time: this is the key caution for any 'read the response, then trade' rule

question: Does a quote change bring prints?
interpretation: The completed group after a midpoint move carries a print 35-39% of the time versus 3-4% after a flat group, with the next print 0.3-0.4 ms later: trading follows quote changes immediately, at message speed.
unresolved_aspects: 0.3 ms lead is algorithmic reaction or the same sweep; not separable here

question: Is there more classified activity just before a family start than at matched controls?
interpretation: Yes in paired counts on every date and lead (total1, total20, displayed lots greater more often than less), while mean differences flip sign with control weighting on Oct 3.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: mid_change5 and mid_change20 contrasts are mixed in sign across dates; flow20 mixed
unresolved_aspects: Mean-difference sign flips (CONFLICTS C7)
measured_lead_time: family starts are not market births

question: Do the four ridge arms beat a sign coin at 1-300 s?
interpretation: Direction agreement 0.33-0.54 across arms/horizons/dates; book and both arms are above baseline at 1-5 s on most dates but no arm is above 0.5 at 60-300 s except isolated cells.
unresolved_aspects: flat outcomes count against direction agreement
measured_lead_time: archived explanatory models

question: After aggression comes to rest at a one-tick spread, which way does the next price change go?
interpretation: Toward the heavy side: ask-heavy touch -> down more than up (0.46/0.48/0.41/0.47 down vs 0.19/0.18/0.29/0.24 up at 1 s); bid-heavy -> up (0.43/0.44/0.44/0.45 up vs 0.22/0.20/0.23/0.22 down).
observed_correspondence: one_tick regime, n=845/818/798/767 (ask-heavy) and 837/948/735/674 (bid-heavy); holds at 5 s and 20 s with smaller gaps
unresolved_aspects: touch_sign is the pre-rest state; spread-crossing cost unmeasured
measured_lead_time: same mechanism as Tier 2 touch imbalance

question: Do the dipole layers together supply most of the knowledge needed for the decisions?
interpretation: No, as measured on these four days. They cover recognition (late), exhaustion/remaining-life sorting (partly definitional) and the window mechanics well; they carry no direction after recognition and no magnitude beyond the saturated |ratio|=1; direction content at 1-5 s lives in touch imbalance, refill and thin-touch flow, which are book layers, and even those decay by 60 s.
contrary_or_absent_correspondence: Pre-recognition drift (ramp) is real but not actionable at the recognition clock
unresolved_aspects: A sub-recognition detector (onset-based, M6-1) was not tested against price outcomes
measured_lead_time: no percentage of market knowledge is asserted
